summary: Frontend-only Design Review Round 2 verification for Open Agri Stack. Every acceptance criterion in the review request passed on desktop 1440x900 and mobile 375x812. Nav logo image, hero H1, blueprint background, 3 architecture layer cards (no L1/L2/L3, no invented SVG diagram), 6 stack rows with clickable detail swaps, 3 Core Registries tabs with EXACTLY the specified items in each panel, 5 Composable Applications cards + compose bookend, no progress bars/coverage/composer in build section, Resources cards, Footer with logo + 2026 copyright, mobile menu toggle + registry accordions all verified. Zero console errors, zero warnings.

issues: /oas-logo.png asset contains a typo — reads 'OpenAgiStack' (missing the 'r' in 'Agri'). Very visible on the large hero card. Replace/fix the PNG artwork.

The transparent PNG shows a checkerboard pattern behind the 'oas' logotype because the image transparency shows through what appears to be a light/tint area — the card wrapper renders fine (dark ink) but the image itself contains embedded transparency squares. Should render on a solid ink background or supply an opaque logo.
